name: step183_mcp_conveyor_sorting_checkpoint

invariant_A_normal_parcel_feed_lane1.description: Normal parcel feed debounced, scanned, diverted to Lane 1, counts incremented

invariant_B_divert_lane2.description: Barcode destination 2 routed to Diverter 2, CountLane2 and CountTotal incremented

invariant_C_scanner_timeout_and_unrecogn.description: Scanner timeout (>1.5s) and invalid barcode destinations both route to Reject chute

invariant_D_jam_detection_watchdog.description: JamTimer exceeding JamTimeoutSec asserts JamAlarm, halts conveyor and enters State 90

invariant_E_cylinder_actuator_failure.description: Diverter cylinder failing to confirm extension within DivertStrokeSec triggers DiverterFault

invariant_F_fault_reset_and_resume.description: ResetFault clears JamAlarm and DiverterFault; system resumes operation via StartPB

invariant_G_estop_immediate_trip.description: EStop=FALSE immediately transitions to State 99, de-energizing all actuators

invariant_H_multi_client_stdio_concurren.description: Zero cross-talk verified across concurrent JSON-RPC clients on partitioned %R250 vs %R260

invariant_I_hardware_download_lockout.description: Hardware download commands 32827 and 33149 intercepted fail-closed
